log(x) or log(1 + x) of number columns.

Takes the log of each chosen column in base e, 10 or 2, to pull in a long right tail or steady exponential growth. log(1 + x) keeps zeros; plain log needs values above 0.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Preprocessing](../categories/preprocessing.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `LogTransform` |
| Search words | log, log1p, log10, log2, skew, stabilize, time, series |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| columns | `columns` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Columns to transform (empty = numeric auto-detect) |
| label_col | `label_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Label column to exclude. |
| exclude_columns | `exclude_columns` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Additional columns to exclude from numeric auto-detect (comma-separated) |
| base | `base` | Choice | `natural` | `natural`, `log10`, `log2` | The run | Log base: e (natural), 10 or 2. |
| use_log1p | `use_log1p` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | log(1 + x): keeps zeros; values must be above -1. Off: log(x), values above 0. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
